text: True or False: The most promising near-term photonic network-on-chip application is fine-grained optical routing between individual CPU cores, rather than chiplet-to-chiplet links.
explanation: False. The strongest near-term case is chiplet-to-chiplet (for example, replacing the ~10 mm electrical HBM memory interface with optics), where physics favors optics and 3D bonding keeps integration manageable. Core-to-core optical routing faces severe thermal and integration hurdles and is a longer-term target.
